## Balance carried forward

The balance carried forward is $1,510.15: the $1,523.10 brought forward, plus income of $2,519.40, less expenditure of $2,532.35.

Emergency supplies went over budget because the committee bought extra blankets for the community hall. The overspend was met from the savings on meetings and administration.

## Examination and approval

These accounts were examined by the two honorary auditors on April 9, 2026 and approved at the annual general meeting on April 26, 2026.

Auditors: Priya Sandhu and Owen Marsh
